title: Cat Fishing
subtitle: Wait quietly, wonder what's next
description: One afternoon, one cat, one bamboo rod. You never know what the next cast will bring — maybe a silver crucian, maybe a moonlight koi.

catalog.eyebrow: A eighth glimmer has woken up
catalog.cardDescription: One afternoon, one cat, one bamboo rod. You never know what the next cast will bring.

milestones.title: First catch
milestones.text: One fish on the bank. It's not big, but it's yours.

milestones.title: The patience of a cat
milestones.text: You can now sit perfectly still for over three minutes. For a cat, this is extraordinary.

milestones.title: Good luck today
milestones.text: Every time you moved, you thought 'there must be fish here' — and every time, you were right.

milestones.title: Bucket full
milestones.text: The bucket is almost too heavy to carry. You count the fish, then count them again.

scenes.title: Arriving at the pond
scenes.description: The afternoon pond is quiet. Dragonflies draw circles on the water. You carry a bamboo rod, tail swaying slowly — today is a fishing day.

variants.text: A silver crucian — small, shiny, an honest little fish.
A chubby carp — round and plump, clearly well-fed. You're a little jealous.
A chubby carp — round and plump, clearly well-fed. You're a little jealous.
A red koi! Red and white, like a flame in the water. You crouched down and watched it for a long time.
A loach — slippery, it wriggled three times in your paw and bounced right back into the water. But you definitely touched it.
A silver crucian — small, shiny, an honest little fish.

scenes.title: The water is still
scenes.description: The float drifts quietly. No wind, no fish, only waterweed shadows swaying. You start to wonder if there are any fish in this pond at all.

actions.name: Use a dried fish
actions.hint: Hard to part with, but that's the motivation

scenes.title: The float moved
scenes.description: The float plunges underwater. Ripples burst across the surface — something bit! Your ears shoot straight up.

scenes.title: Feels like a big one
scenes.description: The rod bends into a bow. Something heavy and stubborn is on the line. You put your whole body weight on the rod, tail straight up.

scenes.title: Noon break
scenes.description: The sun is overhead, the rock is warm. You sprawl on it, belly rising and falling. The rod is still in the water, but you've stopped caring.

actions.name: Keep fishing
actions.hint: Haven't caught the big one yet

actions.name: Switch to better bait
actions.hint: Maybe the old one wasn't smelly enough

scenes.title: The last cast
scenes.description: The sun is heading toward the mountains, the pond has turned gold. You decide on one more cast — not because you haven't caught enough, but because this moment is too good.

endings.title: Full Bucket
endings.description: The bucket is too heavy to carry. You stand by the pond watching the fish crowd together, then decide to give one to the calico at your door.

endings.title: The Legendary Cast
endings.description: You caught a moonlight koi. All the quiet, the waiting, the moving — it was all so this one cast could happen.

endings.title: Today's Catch Was Sunshine
endings.description: Only two or three small fish in the bucket, but your fur is warm from the sun and your belly is full of dough and dandelion seeds. Fishing was never just about the fish.
